title: Berlin Address Books - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **Start with the street, not a name.** Many Berlin address books have a street section listing, house by house, the owner, the manager and every registered tenant.
**The books run from 1799 to 1943,** yearly from 1822, and the ZLB has them all online for free.
**The gap:** no address book after 1943. Phone books start in 1954 (West) and 1955 (East), and only list people with a phone.
**Aerial photos show your block in 1928,** almost citywide, plus later flights. Geoportal Berlin publishes them under an open licence.
**The building file dates the house itself.** It sits at the district's Bauaktenarchiv; fees start at EUR 36, and tenants need the owner's written authority.
**If the building is gone,** the Landesarchiv holds about 120,000 files of demolished buildings, with an online card index by street.
**For 1933 to 1945,** search the Stolpersteine database by street, not only by house.
